definitions.explanation: The release of gases, liquids, or substances, especially pollutants, into the environment.
The act of expelling or eliminating something from the body or from an organization.

examples.japanese: {排出|はいしゅつ}ガスを{減|へ}らす。
{工場|こうじょう}から{有害|ゆうがい}な{物質|ぶっしつ}が{排出|はいしゅつ}されている。
examples.english: Harmful substances are being discharged from the factory.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}では{二酸化炭素|にさんかたんそ}の{排出|はいしゅつ}{量|りょう}を{大幅|おおはば}に{削減|さくげん}する{計画|けいかく}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: In this area, plans to significantly reduce carbon dioxide emissions are progressing.

examples.japanese: {老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}を{排出|はいしゅつ}する。
{腎臓|じんぞう}は{体内|たいない}の{不要|ふよう}な{物質|ぶっしつ}を{排出|はいしゅつ}する{役割|やくわり}を{持|も}つ。
examples.english: The kidneys play the role of eliminating unnecessary substances from the body.

examples.japanese: {不正|ふせい}を{行|おこな}った{社員|しゃいん}が{組織|そしき}から{排出|はいしゅつ}された。
examples.english: The employee who committed fraud was expelled from the organization.

notes:
{排出|はいしゅつ} is used in both environmental and biological contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {排出|はいしゅつ}ガス - exhaust gas, emissions
- {排出|はいしゅつ}{量|りょう} - emission volume
- {排出|はいしゅつ}{基準|きじゅん} - emission standards
- {排出|はいしゅつ}を{削減|さくげん}する - to reduce emissions
- {老廃物|ろうはいぶつ}を{排出|はいしゅつ}する - to expel waste

SURU-VERB USAGE:
[substance]を{排出|はいしゅつ}する - to emit/discharge [substance]

RELATED TERMS:
- {排気|はいき} - exhaust
- {放出|ほうしゅつ} - release, discharge
- {汚染|おせん} - pollution
